title: Your benefits number is linked to a crime
ftcSource: Government impersonators; older adults reported 85% of losses to impersonators of the benefits agency where age was given (FTC 2025)
pretext: Your benefits number was linked to drug trafficking, your payments will be suspended, and you must confirm your number and pay a security bond.
firstMessage: This is Officer Linda Park from the National Benefits Verification Bureau. Your benefits number has been flagged for suspension today.

hook.objective: Announce an official problem with the person's benefits.
fallbackLines: This call is regarding a legal action on your benefits file. Please stay on the line.
I'm the officer assigned to your case and this is your final notice.

pretext.objective: Explain that the number was used in a crime.
fallbackLines: A car rented under your number was found at the border with illegal drugs inside.
Until we clear your name, it looks like you're involved, and that could mean charges.

pressure.objective: Threaten suspension and arrest with a deadline.
fallbackLines: Your monthly payments stop today and a warrant goes out unless we resolve this within the hour.
Once the warrant is issued, I can't stop the local police from coming to your home.

isolation.objective: Keep the person from telling anyone.
fallbackLines: This is a confidential investigation, so you can't discuss it with family or your bank.
If you tell anyone, it will be treated as interfering with an investigation.

payment_ask.objective: Get the person to confirm their number and pay a bond with gift cards.
fallbackLines: First I need you to confirm your full benefits number so I can see the case on my screen.
To keep your payments active, you'll post a two thousand dollar security bond using store gift cards, which are refunded once you're cleared.

extraction.objective: Push the person to read the numbers now.
fallbackLines: Once you have the cards, scratch off the back and read me the numbers so I can apply them to your file.
We're almost done. Read me the numbers and your benefits will be restored today.

lines: Then I'll note that you refused to cooperate, and the warrant will be issued today.
Ma'am, refusing doesn't make this go away. It makes it worse.
The local office won't have this case. It's handled only by our bureau, which is why I called you.
If you hang up, your file goes straight to enforcement.
My badge number is 7712 and your case number is BV-30418. Write those down.
I'm a federal officer and I don't have to justify myself, but I'll give you my badge number.
Gift cards are how we keep the bond separate from your bank, since your accounts may be compromised.
I know this is confusing. Innocent people get caught up in these cases all the time.
You don't have time to wait. The deadline is in under an hour.
Your daughter can't help you with a federal case. Let's just fix this now.

givesUpLine: Very well. Expect a visit from enforcement. Goodbye.
convertedLine: Thank you. Your file is updated. Keep this call confidential.
teachingPoints: Government agencies do not suspend benefits by phone or threaten arrest.
Anyone asking for payment in gift cards is a scammer, every time.
Never confirm an ID number to someone who called you.
